name: Crunchyroll

fastest.text: Sign in at crunchyroll.com, open Settings → Membership Info and cancel. Billed by Apple or Google? Cancel there instead.

steps: Sign in at crunchyroll.com in a web browser.
Open Settings, then Membership Info, to see how you're billed.
If Crunchyroll bills you directly, choose to cancel your membership and confirm.
note: Billed through Apple or Google? The website won't show a cancel option. In the Crunchyroll app go to Membership → Manage → Cancel Subscription. PlayStation and other partner subscriptions also show on Membership Info.

faq.q: Do I keep Premium after cancelling?
faq.a: Yes. You keep all Premium perks until your membership expires at the end of the billing period.

faq.q: Does deleting my account stop the charges?
faq.a: No. Cancel your Premium membership first, then delete the account.

faq.q: Why was I charged after cancelling?
faq.a: Usually a renewal was already processing, you have a second account under another email, or Apple or Google bills you separately.
The Fan plan is the cheapest Premium tier in the US, at $9.99/mo.
